Prompt to build this component

When to use it

When to use

  • To show one slide of an HTML deck in the design: a 16:9 sheet of paper with its title and its points, the page's own content, not Pipeup's.
  • In a screen, as the stage the pins and the comment control sit on.

When not to use

  • For a card or a panel of Pipeup's own: use cmp-card or the comments panel.
  • For a document: the page's flowing content is not a slide.
Variants, anatomy, accessibility, interaction and content rules

Variants

Not applicable: one look. To add variants, replace this line with one bullet per variant, each a variant id, a dash and what it is for.

Anatomy

  • Root: <section class="ds-slide" aria-label="Slide <n> of <m>">, a 16:9 sheet with an ink edge and a hard shadow.
  • Title: <h2 class="ds-slide__title">.
  • Body: <div class="ds-slide__body">, the slide's points as a list or paragraphs.
  • Number: <p class="ds-slide__number">2 / 3</p>, in the typewriter face at the bottom corner.
  • Pins (with-pins): <div class="ds-slide__pins">, the layer over the slide where pins sit; in a mock they are drawn in a row at the top-right corner as a stand-in for their exact spots.

Accessibility

  • A region named by its number, so screen readers hear which slide is showing.
  • The deck's own controls (previous, next) sit outside the slide and keep working in comment mode.

Interaction

  • Turning the deck replaces one slide with the next: the leaving slide fades out and the arriving one fades in over --ds-motion-settle on --ds-motion-ease (data-ds-arriving for one frame, data-ds-leaving until hidden); the pins of the leaving slide go with it, and the arriving slide's pins come in with it (int-04).
  • The slide itself never answers hover or press (int-01 does not apply): it is content.

Content rules

  • The title is the slide's own words; the number reads "n / m".

Do and don't

  • Do keep the slide at 16:9 and let it scale to the room it has.
  • Don't restyle the deck's content: Pipeup draws over it, never into it.
